earnings.title: Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Net sales of $4,313 million, 61% higher than third quarter 2025.
Diluted EPS grew 91% to $1.95 and adjusted diluted EPS (1) grew 78% to $2.21 compared to third quarter 2025.

Vertiv reported third quarter net sales of $4,313 million, an increase of $1,637 million, or 61%, compared to third quarter 2025, reflecting 55% organic sales growth and approximately 6% contribution from acquisitions.
Adjusted operating margin of 25.2%, up 290 basis points compared to third quarter 2025.
Operating cash flow of $794 million and adjusted free cash flow (1) of $652 million, up 64% and 50%, respectively, compared to third quarter 2025.

quotes.text: We are in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout and it's accelerating.
quotes.by: Giordano Albertazzi, Vertiv's Chief Executive Officer

quotes.text: The companies that will define the digital age are the ones investing ahead of the curve and delivering for customers, and that is what we are doing.

outlook: Vertiv Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 with Net Sales Growth of 61%, Organic Orders Growth over 100% and Diluted EPS Growth of 91% (Adjusted Diluted EPS Growth of 78%); Raises Full Year 2026 Guidance Across All Key Metrics
Expects fourth quarter 2026 net sales of $4,413 million and organic sales growth of 50%, each at the midpoint of guidance, compared to fourth quarter 2025.
Expects fourth quarter 2026 diluted EPS of $2.08 and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.25, each at the midpoint of guidance, an increase of 82% and 65%, respectively, compared to fourth quarter 2025.
Expects full year 2026 net sales of $14,650 million and organic sales growth of 38%, each at the midpoint of guidance, compared to full year 2025.

items.heading: We rely on the continued growth of our customers’ critical infrastructure systems, in particular data center and communication infrastructure, to grow our business, operations and revenue, and any decreases in demand in these infrastructures could lead to a decrease in demand for our product offerings.
